text:
maya: quick design review — i'm worried the 'ghost' hover state for disabled role chips is too low-contrast on dark mode. also the tooltip copy feels vague. sending figma in a sec. :eyes:
liam: thanks — can you drop the frame id? trying to triage before sync.
maya: figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/roles-grid-v3?node-id=42%3A7 — frame 'roles-grid-hover-dark'
liam: noted. main questions: 1) is this just visual or does hover enable keyboard focus? 2) does SSO enforcement change chip affordance?
samir: implementation note — current chip uses opacity: 0.16 for disabled bg over #0f1724, meets visual style but might not meet 4.5:1. adding focus outline for keyboard is cheap.
elaine: a11y check: opacity 0.16 on #0f1724 gives contrast ~3.8:1 for the label. below WCAG AA for normal text. small fix: raise disabled label to 0.28 or add a 1px border at 40% white. keyboard focus must be visible (not just color change).
maya: ok — option A: increase label contrast; option B: keep low contrast but add a clear focus ring for keyboard + tooltip copy that explicitly says 'not selectable'. pref for A for clarity.
liam: copy tweak proposal for tooltip: "Role unavailable for this organization. Contact your admin to change access." shorter alt: "Not available — contact admin." thoughts?
elaine: prefer first sentence, but suggest adding "SSO-enforced roles cannot be granted here" only when SSO mode is on. otherwise it'll confuse.
samir: quick feasibility — we can runtime-toggle tooltip text based on org.sso_mode flag. but need product to give exact messages. also note that adding border increases visual noise for dense grid, so may need spacing tweak.
maya: visual alternative: thin inset stroke on disabled chips + updated label weight 500. i'll post mock with comparison.
liam: also flag: audit log navigation — if you click a disabled role in the grid we currently show a toast 'no-op'. product ask: should we 1) open audit log filtered to role changes, 2) show help modal, or 3) block with tooltip?
samir: from an eng POV, opening audit log with a pre-filter is easiest and provides value. modal is heavier. toast is simplest but not helpful.
elaine: opening audit log is fine if it lands keyboard-accessible and announced by screen readers. ensure the link has aria-label like "Open audit log filtered to role X".
maya: i'll mock the audit-log flow in figma + include keyboard focus states and the adjusted contrast values.
liam: timeline — can we get designs and copy by EOD Friday? we'll put on next sprint if devs sign off.
samir: dev sign-off pending once we see final contrast numbers + whether we use border or weight tweak. should be doable in one sprint.
a11y-bot: automated scan: roles-grid-hover-dark frame — low contrast issues detected on 'disabled-chip-label' (contrast 3.8:1). Recommend: label color #bfc7d6 or add 1px border color #2b3440 at 40% to reach 4.5:1.
maya: perfect — i'll update mocks and post updated figma link here when ready. :+1:
liam: thanks team — i'll write the copy variants and tie to SSO flag. sync tomorrow 10am if needed. :calendar:
